what_was_built: API-key authentication (X-API-Key and Authorization: Bearer) for all protected endpoints.
Safe client identity derivation using SHA-256 token hashing (no secrets in logs or state).
Thread-safe in-process sliding-window rate limiter for upload and analyze endpoints with HTTP 429 and standard headers.
Encrypted storage at rest using Fernet (authenticated AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) under data/uploads/.
Zero-plaintext-on-disk guarantee with in-memory decryption strictly during pipeline processing.
Dedicated structured audit logging emitting [AUDIT] JSON records with safe metadata only.
Automated data retention policy and cleanup mechanism purging expired artifacts and in-memory jobs.
Public privacy and retention policy endpoint (GET /v1/privacy-policy) documenting forward frontend requirements.
Automated security test suite covering all 16 specification points.
Full Acceptance Gates 1-6 live verification script (verify_prompt_16.py).

authentication_design.mechanism: API-Key authentication via header X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer <token>
authentication_design.configuration: Dynamically sourced from API_KEYS (comma-separated) or API_KEY environment variables
authentication_design.secret_management: No secrets hardcoded in code, tests, or handoff artifacts; constant-time comparison via secrets.compare_digest
authentication_design.error_behavior: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with generic error messages and zero credential leakage

encryption_design.algorithm: Fernet (AES-128-CBC with PKCS7 padding and HMAC-SHA256 authenticated encryption)
encryption_design.key_source: STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable (with secure ephemeral fallback for local dev)
encryption_design.key_protection: NEVER logged, committed, or returned through API responses/errors
encryption_design.at_rest_format: Binary Fernet ciphertext saved as data/uploads/{doc_id}.enc (starts with gAAAAA)
encryption_design.plaintext_lifetime: Exclusively in volatile memory during upload reception and synchronous pipeline execution
encryption_design.disk_plaintext_inspection: Confirmed 0 substring occurrences of contract text on disk

retention_policy.enforcement_mechanism: Automated scan and deletion of expired .enc and .meta.json files with corresponding JOB_STORE record purging
retention_policy.audit_log_retention: Audit log records are preserved for security accountability

fields: event_type (AUTH_FAILURE, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD, DOCUMENT_ANALYZE, JOB_STATUS_CHECK, JOB_RESULTS_FETCH, FEEDBACK_SUBMIT, RETENTION_CLEANUP)
action (HTTP method + route or system action)
audit_log_schema.confidentiality_guarantee: Zero contract text, clause text, raw filenames, or API/encryption keys logged

confidentiality_guarantees: Contracts are encrypted at rest using authenticated symmetric encryption (Fernet AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256).
Plaintext contract content is NEVER written to server logs, stdout, or audit records.
Plaintext contract text exists exclusively in volatile memory buffers during active ML pipeline analysis.
No uploaded contract text is transmitted to external paid APIs, third-party LLMs, or unauthorized third parties.
Uploaded documents and associated temporary artifacts are automatically purged upon expiration of the retention window.
Security audit logs capture non-reversible identity hashes and event metadata, never contract contents or credentials.
privacy_retention_policy_text.forward_requirement: Prompt 17 UI must visibly display this privacy and retention notice to users prior to accepting any contract file upload.

metrics_provenance: All execution times, HTTP status codes, test counts (89 passed, 2 skipped), and verification logs represent actual live runs executed in this session on genuine EDGAR sample contract data. Zero metrics were estimated or synthetic unless explicitly marked.
known_limitations: Rate limiter is process-local and in-memory; multi-instance horizontal scaling would require distributed state (e.g., Redis).
Job execution queue remains in-memory threading (scheduled for durable queue migration in Prompts 18/19).
Encrypted storage is on local filesystem (Cloudflare R2 / S3 storage deferred to cloud deployment).
Frontend privacy banner is specified as a forward requirement for Prompt 17.
starting_point_for_prompt_17: FastAPI backend is hardened with authenticated endpoints, encrypted storage, rate limiting, audit logging, and data retention. Prompt 17 can now proceed to build the production frontend interface, surfacing the mandatory pre-upload privacy notice and integrating with the authenticated /v1/ endpoints.
